data.title: CSPC’s ADC SYS6010 Wins Breakthrough Status in China for Hard-to-Treat Lung Cancer
data.description:
CSPC Pharmaceutical Group ( (HK:1093) ) has provided an update.

CSPC Pharmaceutical Group announced that its antibody-drug conjugate SYS6010 has received Breakthrough Therapy Designation from China’s National Medical Products Administration for recurrent or metastatic actionable genomic alteration-negative non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer that has failed prior immunotherapy and platinum-based chemotherapy. The EGFR-targeting therapy has shown significantly superior efficacy to standard second-line chemotherapy, including more than doubling progression-free survival, and is currently being evaluated in a Phase III trial as monotherapy in this hard-to-treat patient group.

The designation underscores SYS6010’s potential clinical and commercial significance in a large lung cancer segment with limited effective options, where NSCLC accounts for about 85% of cases and a substantial share is genomic alteration-negative. SYS6010 has already secured three other Breakthrough Therapy Designations in China for various advanced solid tumors, reinforcing CSPC’s standing as an emerging leader in innovative oncology treatments and signaling meaningful implications for patients, healthcare providers and the company’s growth trajectory.
